text: Fir'awna wi'ani dental mun ngal: Ko onon yo dental, mi anndanaa on reweteeɗo, si wanaa min. Ko an yo Haamaana, huɓɓanam yiite e loopal ngal, haa wula, mahiranaa lam huɓeere toowunde, ndaarugol no mi ƴellitora e Reweteeɗo Muusaa On; tawde miɗo sikki mo fenoowo, e ko o nodditorta Nulaaɗo Alla e am, min e yimɓe am.
